description: This file defines a RetrieverTool class for integrating retrievers into a flow-based system, including a DynamicStructuredTool subclass for flexible tool invocation with schema validation and flow context injection.

classes.name: DynamicStructuredTool
classes.description: A subclass of StructuredTool that supports dynamic schema validation, flow context injection, and asynchronous invocation with callback management.

classes.name: Retriever_Tools
classes.description: A class implementing INode that initializes a retriever tool with configurable parameters and integrates it into a flow system.

methods.name: call
methods.description: Executes the tool with input validation, callback handling, and flow context injection, returning the result as a string.

methods.name: _call
methods.description: Internal method that prepares flow configuration and invokes the user-defined function.

methods.name: setFlowObject
methods.description: Sets the flow object used for injecting flow properties into the tool's execution context.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the retriever tool with parameters from node data, setting up the retrieval function with optional metadata filtering.
